stig: Cisco IOS Router NDM STIG, V3R8
title: Password Storage Protection
requirement: The Cisco router must only store cryptographic representations of passwords.

stig: Cisco IOS Router NDM STIG, V3R8
title: Mandatory DoD Notice Display
requirement: The Cisco router must display the Standard Mandatory DoD Notice and Consent Banner before granting access.
fix_summary: Configure `banner login` with the complete DoD-approved warning text.

stig: Cisco IOS Router NDM STIG, V3R8
title: Failed Login Attempt Lockout
requirement: The Cisco router must enforce a limit of three consecutive invalid logon attempts, locking the account for 15 minutes.

stig: Cisco IOS Router NDM STIG, V3R8
title: Remote Maintenance Session Integrity
requirement: The Cisco router must use a FIPS-validated HMAC to protect the integrity of remote maintenance sessions.
fix_summary: Configure `ip ssh server algorithm mac hmac-sha2-256`.
check_pattern: ip ssh server algorithm mac hmac-sha2-256

stig: Cisco IOS Router NDM STIG, V3R8
title: Login Attempt Auditing
requirement: The Cisco router must generate audit records when successful and unsuccessful logon attempts occur.
fix_summary: Enable `login on-failure log` and `login on-success log`.
